items.title: Louis Tio Interview, 1960-10-26
items.q: The interviewee (Louis Tio) never mentions Ralph Collins. Ralph Collins is identified only as a member of the interviewing team present at the recording.

ctx.x: No, my brother was strictly to music, all his life, he never did anything but music. That's the reason why I made him so famous, he could, there was nothing to music to him, just like drinking a glass of water. Because he never done nothing else in his life but that.

Now there were a few things that probably Ralph would like to ask too, Ralph's trying to learn clarinet a little, about your brother, do you remember what kind of an instrument he had? Anything about his instrument, if it was how many keys, or if it was Albert or system, or what kind of a clarinet it was? What maker or anything at all?
No, it was an Ebony, black Ebony, but I didn't know the name, but I forgot about it.
